title: A Dual-Phase-Controlled Dynamic Latched Amplifier for High-Speed and Low-Power DRAMs
figure_number: Fig. 5. (a) Block diagram of cycle-time-progressive (CTP) control circuits. (b) Schematic of CTP control circuits.
function_summary: Dual-Phase-Controlled Dynamic Latched Amplifier: Two circuit technologies are used in the DDL amplifier to achieve 200-MHz operation in a 1-Gb SDRAM using 0.13m technology: a cycle-time-progressive control circuit that increases the operating frequency and a shared DDL amplifier technique that reduces the area penalty of the DDL amplifier.
